admissible_source_evidence.variant_a:
Decision record: group post retention

Subject: how long posts in the shared practice group are kept.
Proposal: shorten the period from ninety days to thirty days.
Outcome: approved by the group steward under the group's standing rules.
Effect: the thirty-day period applies from the start of next month. Members do not need to take any action.
Questions: reply to the steward in the group thread.
admissible_source_evidence.variant_b:
Hi everyone - a quick update on how long posts in our practice group are kept. I have suggested we shorten it from ninety days to thirty. Under our group's standing rules this one is for members to settle, so I have opened a poll in the group thread. If most of you vote yes by the end of this month, the thirty-day period starts next month; otherwise we stay at ninety. Shout in the thread if you have questions!

- your group steward
